result.topic_en: This is not a Riemann calculation page but the closing page of a letter signed by David Hilbert, Privatdozent in Königsberg. He says a result has been fully confirmed, sends his regards, adds Professor Hurwitz's regards, and gives his address.
result.transcription:
Resultat durchaus bestätigt gefun-
den, so dass sonst wohl Alles in Ord-
nung ist.

3

Indem ich mich bestens empfehle und
auch von Professor Hurwitz eine Em-
pfehlung hinzufüge

Hochachtungsvoll

David Hilbert
Privatdozent in Königsberg
Rhesastrasse[?] 10.

items.english: [I have] found the result entirely confirmed, so that otherwise everything is probably in order.
